queries.rationale: direct: concentrate OS access behind one abstraction interface, no scattered #ifdef -> platform-abstraction-layer.md

queries.prompt: I want all our OS calls to go through a struct of function pointers so the engine never calls the OS directly and each platform just fills in the struct

queries.prompt: we're bringing our game engine up on Linux for the first time. What order should I implement things and how do I keep it building while half the platform layer is missing

queries.prompt: the new compiler is throwing a ton of unused-variable warnings and complaining about void foo() declarations that the old build never cared about: is the new toolchain just stricter or are these real

queries.prompt: after switching one of our build targets to 32-bit pointers our hash tables and memcmp comparisons started failing. Why would pointer width break struct comparisons
queries.rationale: porting-strategy / web-wasm: 32-bit pointers change struct padding, breaking hash/memcmp; widen keys, re-pad

queries.prompt: I compiled our C app to wasm with emscripten but the tab just freezes: our main loop is a while(running){tick();} and it never gives control back to the browser
queries.rationale: web-wasm: blocking native loop hangs the tab; use emscripten_set_main_loop cooperative callback

queries.prompt: in our emscripten build fopen returns null for assets that load fine natively. How am I supposed to read data files in the browser
queries.rationale: web-wasm: async I/O, preload into virtual FS (--preload-file) or fetch at runtime

queries.prompt: our renderer is Vulkan but browsers only give me WebGL. I don't want to rewrite the whole backend, can I just get the 2D UI drawing on screen in the browser
queries.rationale: web-wasm: map the UI/2D draw stream down to GL ES, expand compact verts on CPU, defer 3D

queries.prompt: controllers plugged in after my game launches never get picked up. I only scan devices once at startup, how do I detect hotplug
